mapper.select: select distinct A.BENCHMARK_ID as code, A.FINPROD_ID as shortName , A.FINPROD_ID as hidCode FROM FIN_RATE_INFO A INNER JOIN OPT_TARGET_INFO B on B.TARGET_ID = A.BENCHMARK_ID left join trd_product_deal tpd on tpd.totle_trade_id = A.FINPROD_ID where A.BENCHMARK_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) and tpd.is_cancel != 'Y' and A.BENCHMARK_TYPE = #{BENCHMARK_TYPE2}

select distinct A.BENCHMARK_ID as code FROM FIN_RATE_INFO A INNER JOIN OPT_TARGET_INFO B on B.TARGET_ID = A.BENCHMARK_ID left join trd_product_deal tpd on tpd.totle_trade_id = A.FINPROD_ID where A.BENCHMARK_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) and tpd.is_cancel != 'Y' and A.BENCHMARK_TYPE = #{BENCHMARK_TYPE2}

select distinct A.FINPROD_ID as code ,B.TARGET_ID targetId FROM FIN_RATE_INFO A INNER JOIN OPT_TARGET_INFO B on B.TARGET_ID = A.BENCHMARK_ID left join trd_product_deal tpd on tpd.totle_trade_id = A.FINPROD_ID where A.FINPROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) and tpd.is_cancel != 'Y' and A.BENCHMARK_TYPE = #{BENCHMARK_TYPE2}
select FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_RATE_INFO where BENCHMARK_ID = #{finprodId2} and

SELECT opt.TARGET_ID as targetId , mst.VALUATION, TO_CHAR(mst.VAL_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as valDate ,mst.FINPROD_ID2,TO_CHAR(mst.PUBLISH_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as publishDate FROM MST_VAL_OP mst LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO fin ON fin.FINPROD_ID=mst.FINPROD_ID2 AND fin.BENCHMARK_TYPE = #{BENCHMARK_TYPE2} LEFT JOIN OPT_TARGET_INFO opt ON opt.TARGET_ID = fin.BENCHMARK_ID where mst.FINPROD_ID2 = #{finprodId2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and mst.VAL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{valDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
